# Sources

- Canada.ca Content Style Guide:
  [4.6 Numbers](https://design.canada.ca/style-guide/#wp4-6),
  [4.7 Dates](https://design.canada.ca/style-guide/#wp4-7),
  [4.9 Phone numbers](https://design.canada.ca/style-guide/#wp4-9).
  French: [guide de rédaction 4.9](https://conception.canada.ca/guide-redaction/#wp4-9).
  The guide has no apostrophe rule and its own pages mix `'` and `’`.
- OQLF,
  [espacement avant et après les signes de ponctuation](https://vitrinelinguistique.oqlf.gouv.qc.ca/22039/la-typographie/espacement/espacement-avant-et-apres-les-signes-de-ponctuation-et-les-symboles):
  non-breaking space before `:` and inside `« »`, no space before `; ! ?`.
- Peck's English Pointers, "Punctuation myths": Canadian English uses double
  quotation marks, single only inside them. The live page blocks automated
  clients, so this links the
  [archived copy](https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://nos-langues.canada.ca/en/pecks-english-pointers/punct-11-punctuation-myths).
- Straight `'` and `"` are a team convention. The OQLF accepts them in digital
  content when used consistently.
